d:
Bihar ke navada men sharab taskaron dvara pulis ko chakma dene ke lie apnaee gaee anokhi tarkib ka govindpur utpad janch chauki par pardaphash ho gaya hai. utpad vibhag ki tim ne sona-chandi ke prachar ke lie istemal hone vali pikaap gari ke andar bane gupt tahkhane se karib 10 lakh rupye ki videshi sharab baramad ki hai aur mauke se chalak ko giraphtar kar liya hai.
Prachar dhanche ke bhitar gupt tahkhana, devghar se navada laee ja rahi thi sharab
